headline: Virgil Popescu: Hidroelectrica and Nuclearelectrica, profits of over 5.7 billion lei in 2025
summary: Hidroelectrica and Nuclearelectrica were among Romania's most profitable electricity-sector companies, with combined profits above 5.7 billion lei in 2025, according to former energy minister Virgil Popescu.
why: Hidroelectrica is a state-controlled hydropower producer and Nuclearelectrica operates Romania's nuclear plants. Both are major players in the country's electricity market.
